items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, there used to be a blind trumpet player around there, Blind Gilbert. Did you ever know him? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, indeed. I guess so.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . That's not the lyrics at all that that nigga gives. You've seen his niggas, yeah. White people do do that. The street corner? Yes, stand on the corner and play with a guitar and sing, you know? So that's what he was. I can't remember what the devil his number, his name was. The name of his number saved my life. But that nigga could sing good too, yeah. That's very close.
Yeah, there used to be a blind trumpet player around there, Blind Gilbert. Did you ever know him?
